name: project-template-fullstack
description: Template Fullstack Monorepo: Node.js RESTful + Socket.IO + React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 + PostgreSQL Docker / Supabase

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix Backend run typecheck && npm --prefix Frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix Backend run test && npm --prefix Frontend run test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f Database/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f Database/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
